Question: To complaint about the pot holes on the road (Sadak mein gaddha hai, accident ho sakta hai — turant complaint karni hai
Answer: Roads/Public Works wing of IMC. Pothole and road-damage complaints can be marked urgent/safety-risk — flag it as such and include a photo with exact location (main road name + nearest landmark) since exact location matters more for roads than most other complaints.

Question: To request about the new divider/ speed breaker in the my area (Naya divider/speed breaker chahiye, request kaise karu?
Answer: This is a request/suggestion to Roads/Traffic-engineering wing, not a standard grievance — usually routed through the ward councillor or a written request to the zone office rather than the complaint helpline, since it involves engineering assessment, not a fault.
